# Site for sale

> GVM Auctioneers are delighted to offer for sale this serviced C. 0.91 acre site at Derrybeg Lane, Killeigh, Tullamore, Co. Offaly. The property enjoys a superb rural location just off the N80, providing excellent access to Tullamore and the surrounding area.

## Fakta
- Typ: site
- Druh nabídky: sale
- Lokalita: Derrybeg Lane, Killeigh
- Cena: 75 000 €
